purpose: Canonical FWF kernel stateful/mutation test surface, vendored byte-for-byte for the M5 nightly. These are not a Market Fuzzer-authored copy and must never be edited here; regenerate from the canonical repository instead.
note: tests/m5/kernel_stateful/ is a second, separate vendor group. The kernel source snapshot itself is pinned in app/_vendor/fwf_kernel/SOURCE.json; M5 extended that manifest from six to eight files (adding qc.py and semantic_rng.py). Both groups record the same source_commit: the canonical commit that contains every pinned byte (this group's test surface includes the M5 machine_settings budget helper and the three machines routed through it). This commit also carries the M5.2 stateful finding fix: PPE straight-line schedules now cap accumulation at the depreciable base, with a regression test in kernel/tests/test_subledgers.py.
